recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31937; future DeviceUsage maturity changes should be handled in the OO incubator/additional-resources source unless DeviceUsage is migrated back into core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO request to update DeviceUsage to FMM1 after FMG approved the DeviceUsage resource proposal, with the dispositive OO vote recorded as 9-0-0 on 2021-04-19.
initial_application: The request was applied in R5-era source history: b6ddfc5ea0 and c8c1651870 set deviceusage=1 in fhir.ini, 843a2104d2 changed the DeviceUsage StructureDefinition fmm extension to 1, and d879f46657 made follow-up FHIR-31937 build fixes. The published R5 profile reports FMM 1.
additional_context: Current core no longer builds DeviceUsage. source/fhir.ini has no active DeviceUsage entry in [resources] or [fmm], current module/history/resourceguide pages link DeviceUsage to the OO incubator IG, and 2025 OO/FMG discussion tracks DeviceUsage as an Additional Resources/incubator artifact.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because the requested FMM1 state is already present where DeviceUsage is published, and the remaining core DeviceUsage source is outside the current build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asking to update DeviceUsage to FMM1 after FMG approved the resource proposal, with an OO 9-0-0 vote.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent and the target maturity level for the R5 DeviceUsage resource.

evidence_items.summary: OO minutes state DeviceUsage was approved by FMG and record a motion to update DeviceUsage to FMM1, 9 in favor with no negatives or abstentions.
evidence_items.learned: This corroborates the Jira request and shows the resource-proposal approval underlying the maturity change.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commits moved DeviceUsage to FMM1 in fhir.ini and the StructureDefinition and made associated FHIR-31937 build fixes.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was applied in source for R5 before publication.

evidence_items.summary: The checked-in DeviceUsage StructureDefinition still carries structuredefinition-fmm 1, but DeviceUsage is not listed in active [resources] or [fmm].
evidence_items.learned: The remaining core DeviceUsage source is not an active current-build resource, so editing it would not fix the current spec.

evidence_items.summary: The 2025 commit 'Remove OO resources and point to new incubator' removed deviceusage from active fhir.ini sections and rewired narrative links to the OO incubator IG.
evidence_items.learned: Later source history intentionally moved DeviceUsage out of the current core build rather than forgetting the FMM setting.

evidence_items.summary: OO minutes list DeviceUsage among resources for the Additional Resources / incubator IG and note repository and IG-proposal follow-up.
evidence_items.learned: This corroborates external IG ownership of DeviceUsage for current R6 work.

evidence_items.locator: Published R5 and OO incubator DeviceUsage maturity checks
evidence_items.command: curl -LfsS https://hl7.org/fhir/R5/deviceusage.profile.json | jq -r '.url, .version, .status, (.extension[]? | select(.url|test("structuredefinition-fmm|standards-status")) | [.url, (.valueInteger//.valueCode//.valueString)] | @tsv)'; curl -LfsS https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator/StructureDefinition-DeviceUsage.json | jq -r '.url, .version, .status, (.extension[]? | select(.url|test("structuredefinition-fmm|standards-status")) | [.url, (.valueInteger//.valueCode//.valueString)] | @tsv)'; curl -I -LfsS https://build.fhir.org/deviceusage.html
evidence_items.summary: R5 DeviceUsage and current OO incubator DeviceUsage both expose structuredefinition-fmm 1; the current core DeviceUsage page returns 404 while module pages link to the incubator.
evidence_items.learned: The requested FMM state is present in the published/current surfaces that contain DeviceUsage, and current core no longer has a standalone DeviceUsage page.
